basis: Exact-QID OSM bridge plan and current paired RN174 carriageway endpoints establish the full curved 4.1km extent. Main-section/pylon stations, pier spacing and elevations are photo-led approximations using the existing 610m fact, western bridge-way transition and standard Mapzen ground; no surveyed bridge geometry. Landing elevation clears the maximum sampled coarse DEM across the road width; a short flat plateau accommodates skewed map cuts.
